claims.originating_goal: Expand a verified resident device-local KnowledgeVault into provider-neutral cloud-hosted KV peers without reverting to cloud-file bootstrap or silently rewriting existing cloud identity/provenance.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after cloud-peer request source passes hosted validation and merges. Provider authorization/materialization remains runtime work after resident device-local KV installation proof.
collision_boundaries: Do not allow cloud peer operations before resident device-local KV exact readback
Do not use cloud storage as device bootstrap source
Do not silently rewrite existing Google Drive KV identity or ordinal
Do not expose raw credentials or provider session material
Do not claim provider CONNECT/materialization/data movement/replication/AI corpus effects
claims.next_task_after_release: After resident iPhone KV installation proof, bind cloud peer requests to authentic Interlock/InTr provider execution and SKAP credential resolution, beginning with explicit existing Google Drive adoption as the next free ordinal and then new iCloud/cloud peers.
